3_certified_count.delta_explanation: The +10 over expected 2,211 is from Wave 2b replacement items (R12, R13, R18, R21, R22, R23, R24, R25, R28, R33). These 10 items ARE physically present in pack_e_corrected.js and carry 'question_state': 'Certified'. However, they are stubs — their Stem and ExplanationCorrect fields lack substantive content. The S318 Portfolio Impact Analysis (SESSION318_PORTFOLIO_IMPACT_ANALYSIS.json) explicitly states 'wave_2b: certified_not_inserted' with cumulative_certified=2221 when counting certified + wave-2b (line 50 of that file). The 2,211 figure references only items with full production-grade content. The +10 therefore reflects certified-but-stub items awaiting content recovery/re-insertion in S319.

pack_a_corrected.js.assessment: ADVISORY — Unexpected shrinkage of ~79 KB since S718 baseline. The S318 Governance Preservation Audit (reports/SESSION318_GOVERNANCE_PRESERVATION_AUDIT.json) flagged this as 'Pack A hash drift detected (not attributable to S317/S318 pack_e modifications)'. No S318 operations targeted Pack A. Possible causes: whitespace normalization, trailing-comma cleanup, or environmental line-ending conversion. No certified items were removed (481 certified count unchanged from S718). Certified count, item count, and structural integrity unchanged. Root cause investigation deferred to S319 Agent A startup.
